headline: Tibo says a banked reset is being loaded
sourceTimezone: Not provided; X timestamp recorded in UTC
originalTimeText: We are loading a banked reset
scope: Tibo says a banked reset is being loaded into all Plus, Pro, and Business user accounts. He did not provide an availability time or confirm that delivery to every account is complete.

announcement.text: And one more thing. We are loading a banked reset into all accounts of our Plus, Pro and Business users. Let's go!
announcement.translation: 还有一件事。我们正在向所有 Plus、Pro 和 Business 用户的账户装载一次储备重置。开始吧！

note: The earlier 3 AM PDT (10:00 UTC) target was an editorial estimate and has passed. This later post identifies the event as a banked reset and says loading is in progress, but gives no delivery time. Its publication time is not the banked reset's availability time; completion across all accounts has not been independently verified.
